## How a lifecycle is decided

| rule | when | state |
| --- | --- | --- |
| C1 | a connector pack in `packages/provisioning/src/provider-packs.ts` declares this product | the pack's own declaration is classified by `classify()` — the rules already shipped for CAT-000-003 — so this register cannot hold a second opinion about a pack's state |
| C2 | no pack declares this product | `INVENTORY_ONLY` — §6's state for a system recorded to plan migration or coexistence without implying Tenure has an adapter, which is precisely what a §8 planning row is |
